I am a seasoned Fraud Investigation Specialist with over six years of hands-on experience at PT Bank Mega Tbk, specializing in credit card fraud, banking fraud, and misappropriation of customer funds.

Throughout my career, I have leveraged SQL, Python, and BI tools like Tableau and Looker Studio to detect anomalous patterns and build data-driven investigative strategies. I also conducted strategic interviews and interrogations of both internal and external suspects.

Currently, I am sharpening my Data Science and Machine Learning skills through Purwadhika Digital Technology School — combining deep investigative intuition with modern analytical tools.
